message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (around $1 ≈ £0.775), $20 would be roughly **£15.50**.  

Keep in mind that the exact amount can vary slightly depending on the source of the rate and any transaction fees that may apply.
